articleBody:
Before committing to a custom basement layout, having exact details organized saves costly mid-project changes. Use this checklist to verify your space is ready for scaled drawings:

- [ ] Measure floor-to-ceiling heights — This confirms whether finished ceiling drops will accommodate ductwork and recessed lighting.
- [ ] Check foundation walls for active dampness — Any groundwater or moisture seepage must be resolved prior to closing up walls with insulation.
- [ ] Locate the main sewer cleanout and rough plumbing stubs — Positioning new bathrooms near existing drains cuts down on concrete trenching.
- [ ] Map out the electrical service panel and utility meters — Building codes require dedicated working clearances in front of all panels.
- [ ] Record furnace and water heater intake clearances — Heating equipment demands proper airflow and routine servicing space.
- [ ] Identify egress window dimensions in planned bedrooms — Sleeping areas require specific emergency escape openings by code.
- [ ] Document support post and beam locations — Structural columns dictate room dimensions and wall placement options.
- [ ] Outline unfinished storage requirements — Allocating utility space early ensures mechanicals remain serviceable later.

How to use this checklist:
Walk your lower level with a tape measure and flashlight to confirm these points before meeting with your designer. When you are ready to plan your build, contact Abraham Becerra at HH Remodeling LLC at 303-505-0866.
